comment: Throughput regression floors (cycles/s) enforced by test/phase17-performance.test.ts. 'reference' is an informational measurement (local, Bun, after the Phase 7 notifyCycles hot-path fix and guarded fast-run branch specialization; see commit history). 'floor' is the enforced minimum and is set well below reference (~2.5-3x margin) so ordinary machine/CI variance does not flake the suite — the goal is to catch large regressions (e.g. reintroduced per-instruction allocations), not micro-changes. Track fine-grained numbers with `bun run bench`. Bump these only with a measured rationale.
